# Articulation Kind

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ArticulationKind`](gmeow-ArticulationKind.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ArticulationKind>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

An articulation or attack quality applied to a [`ToneEvent`](gmeow-ToneEvent.md) — staccato, legato, tenuto, accent, marcato, pizzicato, harmonic, etc. A value vocabulary of individuals; never subclassed ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ArticulationKind`](gmeow-ArticulationKind.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
